data.title: 不知火舞 · 海滨道场的扇子与浪花
data.description: 【海滨道场露台·正午】不知火舞穿着红色泳装外搭白色短衫，赤脚坐在木质海台边练习折扇；一朵浪花越过台阶，她用扇面接住水珠，随后对镜头摆出胜利姿势。
data.action: 海滨木台边练扇接住浪花水珠，转向镜头摆出胜利姿势
data.lighting: bright noon sun on red fabric and spray
data.mood: 把晨训变成热烈海滨假日
data.promptProse: Mai Shiranui sits barefoot at the seaside dojo deck in a crimson athletic swimsuit and white wrap shirt, red ribbon sandals set beside her. She performs a crisp folding-fan flourish to catch spray crossing the steps, then turns with a playful victory pose. The horizontal medium portrait includes the low deck edge and sea. Bright noon light catches red fabric and fan droplets, with wet highlights along the steps and darker shade beneath the deck.
